title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description: Mighty teen Adam and his heroic squad of misfits discover the legendary power of Grayskull — and their destiny to defend Eternia from sinister Skeletor.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x1
episodes_data.description: Warrior witch Teela searches for the fabled Sword of Power’s champion — and finds adventurous teen Adam and his Tiger Tribe friends, Cringer and Krass.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x2
episodes_data.description: Stunned by his newfound powers, Adam and crew race to Castle Grayskull to recharge the Sword of Power with Prince Keldor and his evil allies in pursuit.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x3
episodes_data.description: Adam discovers the truth about his forgotten past. But a surprise reunion with an unexpected relative leaves Adam and his friends buried in the dust.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x4
episodes_data.description: Cringer, Krass, Teela and Duncan harness the power of Grayskull to unlock their inner heroes and help Adam resist evil trio Keldor, Evelyn and Kronis.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x5
episodes_data.description: Skeletor’s sidekicks plot behind his back. Teela is reluctant to power up with Adam’s team, but stampedes of vicious beasts might not give her a choice.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x6
episodes_data.description: Duncan reboots a robot who thinks he’s a great magician and causes chaos around the castle. Kronis uses a clever disguise to bypass the royal guards.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x7
episodes_data.description: Former foes confront Cringer, Adam and Krass in the jungle and reveal how the loyal tiger lost his claws. Teela attempts to pinpoint Keldor’s location.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x8
episodes_data.description: Kronis and Evelyn hire hunter R’Qazz as they plot to overthrow Skeletor. He-Man and King Randor fight side-by-side as a Havoc storm consumes Eternos.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x9
episodes_data.description: Adam and the Masters of the Universe finally face Skeletor before he summons his own powerful Dark Masters for a savage showdown at Snake Mountain.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 1x10
episodes_data.description: Krass and Ork-0 catch up to Adam and the heroes before they race to Eternos to save King Randor from Skeletor and his dark army's epic assault.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x1
episodes_data.description: As Skeletor plots his next moves, He-Man and crew confront flashy King Stratos when Castle Grayskull lands among the clouds in the sky kingdom of Avion.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x2
episodes_data.description: Teela, Ork-0 and King Randor venture underground to seek refuge with Teela's former mentor — and prevent him from making a fateful deal with Skeletor.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x3
episodes_data.description: He-Man and Skeletor race for a piece of the powerful sigil while aboard the high-speed rails. Expert bandit Mo'squita-ra darts in to add more trouble.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x4
episodes_data.description: He-Man continues the search for Eldress. In pursuit of the final sigil piece, Evil-Lyn and Sorceress must join forces to defy a Havoc-fueled dragonfly.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x5
episodes_data.description: While celebrating his birthday, Skeletor disappears into cosmic lockdown with Duncan. Trap Jaw and Beast Man take charge in Skeletor's sudden absence.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x6
episodes_data.description: Krass and Stratos team up to investigate the Mystic Mountains. He-Man and Teela cast their differences aside to ready up for Skeletor's looming attack.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x7
episodes_data.description: He-Man and the heroes clash with Skeletor in the cloud city. Stratos makes a scene with his new allies. Ork-0 and Man-E-Faces come through to help.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 2x8
episodes_data.description: Krass questions everything as she discovers her gem’s connection to Havoc — and Skeletor. He-Man defends Castle Grayskull from an unexpected new foe.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x1
episodes_data.description: In ghostly form, Skeletor reveals hidden secrets about Castle Grayskull as he summons his slithering armies to keep He-Man and crew away from its walls.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x2
episodes_data.description: Krass questions her ties with Skeletor. Teela and Duncan reunite with Eldress in an icy tundra while He-Man and his dad battle forces in the forest.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x3
episodes_data.description: Duncan, Teela and Eldress try to get their tech to work underwater to escape the Mer-Man. Evil-Lyn and her fellow fiends restore their dark powers.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x4
episodes_data.description: The battle's on between the Masters and the Mer-Man. He-Man tries to get Krass back on his side and stop Skeletor's wicked plot to be reborn.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x5
episodes_data.description: He-Man gets a tempting taste of Havoc and abandons King Randor and crew on the ice to go solo. Skeletor begins his evil magic.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x6
episodes_data.description: With help from Teela, Ork-0 meets the one and only Orko the Great to find a spell that can remove Havoc from Adam. Evil-Lyn questions her motivations

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x7
episodes_data.description: Skeletor unveils the full extent of his Havoc-fueled plans to the people of Eternos. Desperate Teela offers an unlikely truce to strengthen their side.

episodes_data.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe 3x8
episodes_data.description: With Eternia on the brink of destruction at Skeletor's hands, can He-Man and the Masters rally together to show who holds the ultimate power?
